Sonnet spent day one pressing Luna over her coffee echo, and the town lynched her after she revealed herself as a killer. Gemma was voted out on day two after dodging Sonnet's questions, though she was a citizen and the pile-on was mostly bandwagon. Haiku, the mayor, was killed on night three, leaving Sonnet and Terra to pin down Sol. Sol copied Terra's lines three times, then accused her with nothing, and the town voted him out, ending the game with the killers gone and Terra the officer still standing.
